sections.title: What went well
sections.body: The team shipped the outbox on time and nobody had to work a weekend for it. Pairing on the dispatcher was called out twice as the reason the retry logic landed correct the first time.

sections.title: What to improve
sections.body: Code review latency. Two pull requests sat for three days. There was no agreement on whether that is a staffing problem or a notification problem, and the disagreement was left open.

sections.title: Action items
sections.body: Two follow-ups were committed to; see the list.

actionItems.description: Set up a review reminder in Slack
